meta.title: WPS cloud sync
meta.description: Mirrors DSH sessions, the scheduled-task catalog, and workspace folders into a local WPS sync folder so another device can pull copies through WPS. Open Plugins, select WPS cloud sync, then choose the sync folder; each session header also has upload and auto-upload controls. Uploads write Markdown and JSON files under DSH-Sync and never call WPS APIs. Auto-upload is on by default and stops when the bundle is disabled. Pulled sessions and tasks are read-only archives and cannot be imported at runtime; pulled workspaces can be restored only into a target folder you choose, skipping or renaming existing files, never overwriting.
